note: THE CHOOSER (the user 10 Nov, Q5): a row's alike is the chooser shape that opens it (the 8 types with a real plane: Cub, Jodel, C172, Chinook, Tiger Moth, Stearman, Camel, the Twin-582 floatplane); a shape row (shape, no file: the Spitfire, the Skymaster) is the chooser's shape itself, built at its birth. THE CANON (the user 12 Nov, yes to all): every player row has its own name and registration (reg; AIRCRAFT-LOOKS paints the marks on the planes), the reproductions are the planes REAL-FIGURES tests (tools/real_refs.js PLANES, both ways), a test plane's name starts 'Test copy: ', and 'official' and 'Metal' are retired as names; name a plane by its row: list:50 Cessna 172. A row with rides is the developer's until its file lands (it would not open). THE PLANE LIST (the user 10 Nov, the classes; one row per plane, nothing twice): reproduction = the types REAL-FIGURES tests against the real aircraft; story = the story's planes and the career's fleet (the validated Cessnas only); original = the game's own designs; wip; next = a reproduction's next version, until it replaces its type; legacy = the test planes the gates fly; archive = kept, out of the game. The player sees the first four (garage.js PLAYER_CLASSES), the developer all seven. Earlier: the three lists of 4 Nov (official / candidates / internal), every row kept under its number. "you can keep planes for internal testing too, so we have an exhaustive list"): every aeroplane we have, nothing deleted. official / candidates / internal; n = the sheet's number (39, 40: added since). The garage's All planes screen reads this file (internal: dev only); AIRCRAFT-LOOKS draws its sheet from the copy in evidence-2026-10-18/2026-11-04/all-planes/lists.json. A row's door: file (a repo path; over: sections laid over it, the Client Cub as the career hands it over: storyClientSpec is career core, the sandbox does not load it, and the gate holds the two equal), stock (a stock design), gen (the template's own). rides: the ready branch that brings the file. The Market and the contracts keep their own table (CONTRACT_DESIGNS): a row here touches neither. Official only means shown on this list (the user 4 Nov): an official plane does not become a reference plane for the test battery. GATE PLANELISTS holds this file.
